method: empirical-prompt-tuning loop. Per round: fresh executors on frozen scenarios A/B/C with the same visible checklist; hidden grader checks judged by the parent; self-reported unclear points classified (Issue/Cause/General Fix Rule); fixes applied between rounds; holdout scenario added at convergence judgment.
metricNote: Host does not expose tool_uses/duration_ms for subagents. Visible accuracy was 100% in every round from iter1; the discriminating signals are (a) hidden grader checks, (b) new unclear points, (c) self-reported retries and phase weaknesses. Step/duration thresholds could not be measured and are excluded.

rounds.notes: Quint 0.32.0 + Apalache 0.56.1 executed on real models (verify + run + ITF); all false-positive guards passed; retention/ordering/delegation handled correctly.

rounds.notes: Quint fixture tasks completed without syntax retries; minimal example landed. Holdout (subscription cancellation) passed with 100% and found the intended concurrency/billing gaps.

rounds.notes: Permission-denied path followed without probing availability (A/C); budget unit clarified in A. Remaining items are tool-operational minutiae (fixed port, sample reporting) and taxonomy edge cases; two closed post-loop, rest adjudicated.

convergence.reason: The literal stop rule (2 consecutive rounds with zero new unclear points) was not reached: fresh executors surfaced 5–8 micro-items per round, though hidden grader checks and visible accuracy stayed at 100% and the items shifted from contract defects to tool-operational or taxonomy edge cases. Resource cutoff applied per the skill's stopping criteria.
postLoopFixes: reporting.md: state the counting unit in coverage ledgers
residualAdjudications: proposal boundary (options vs rewrite-ready text): existing boundaries suffice; no change
config key vs retrievable document: delegated rule added in iter3; closed
single observation contract / persistence effects: existing 'output/effect' wording and prioritization suffice; no change
principal obligation vs service guarantee reading: both readings kept, downstream server behavior treated as unresolved — existing screening covers this
hypothetical-finding applicability: existing 'mark hypotheses' discipline used; no change
derived vs unresolved with lopsided evidence: taxonomy edge; not fix-worthy in this pass
scratch directory collision and Deliverable-field duplication: harness artifacts, not skill defects
